_comment: Mise Project Schema v0.1 — Reference Document

elements._comment: Element schema reference — not a real element
elements.type: video | audio | image | text | graphic | component
elements.content: HTML string — text and component types only

position._comment: Top-left corner of the element, in stage coordinate units

elements._zIndex_comment: null = auto, stacks by cue firing order. Integer overrides.
elements._background_comment: true pins this element behind all others, regardless of zIndex
elements._flags_comment: zIndexable: whether the audience can reorder this element (e.g. click to bring to front)
elements._visible_comment: Whether the element has a visible DOM wrapper. When false, the element produces audio only with no visual presence. Default: true.
elements._mediaFit_comment: Controls how media fills its box. 'fit' = object-fit: contain (no crop, may letterbox). 'fill' = object-fit: cover (fills box, crops if needed). Never stretches. Default: 'fill'. Applies to image and video types only.
